full_prompt_en: A square-framed rural oil painting shows four small figures standing among large rounded haystacks at the edge of a harvested field. The nearest straw-covered mound dominates the right foreground, its curved side textured with fine ocher marks against the surrounding green. A second mound rises on the left and another sits behind the people, making a loose row of soft domes across the lower half. The figures stand between these forms, seen mostly from behind. Two wear dark long coats and pale brimmed hats, one nearer the left and another near the center-right; a lighter dressed figure stands between them, and a fourth dark figure is partly tucked toward the right-hand mound. Their bodies are simplified into vertical shapes, so the pale hats and upright posture carry more visual weight than individual features. Bands of cut golden grass run horizontally along the bottom edge, then give way to a broad green slope behind the hay. Midground trees form a thick, dark uneven line, while scattered small rounded bales rest on a higher field beyond. The distant hillside and tree mass fill the upper part of the image in olive, moss, and deep blue-green tones. Light arrives softly from the upper left, warming the straw and the top of the field while leaving the trees in dark cool shade. The painted surface is matte and finely stippled, with transitions built from many small marks rather than glossy blending. Distances are compressed into calm horizontal layers, and the rounded haystacks echo the domed tree crowns. The overall composition is quiet and slightly enigmatic, balancing tiny human silhouettes against broad patterned fields and deep green enclosure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形框景的乡村油画里，四个小人物站在收割田地边缘的大圆草垛之间。最近的覆草堆占据右前景，弯曲侧面布满细小赭色笔痕，与周围绿色相对。左侧另有一座草垛，人物身后还有一座，使下半画面形成松散的一列柔圆穹顶。人物站在这些形体之间，主要从背后可见。两人穿深色长外套、戴浅色宽檐帽，一人靠左，另一人靠中右；一个衣着较浅的人站在他们之间，第四位深色人影部分贴近右侧草垛。他们的身体被简化成竖向形状，浅色帽子和直立姿态比个人面貌更有视觉重量。收割后的金色草带沿下缘横向延伸，随后让位给草垛后方宽阔绿坡。中景树木组成浓密、深色且起伏不齐的一线，更高处田里散落着小圆草捆。远处山坡与树群以橄榄绿、苔绿和深蓝绿填满上半画面。柔光从左上方到来，温暖草堆与田地顶部，树群则留在深冷阴影中。画面表面哑光并带细密点状笔触，过渡由许多小痕迹构成，而非光滑融合。距离被压缩成平静的横向层次，圆草垛与树冠的圆顶互相呼应。整体构图安静而略带谜意，以微小人物剪影平衡宽广的纹理田野和深绿包围。
style_prompt_en: The image has a matte, finely stippled oil-paint surface with gently geometric countryside shapes and compressed spatial layers. Moss green, olive, muted gold, and deep blue-green cover large adjoining areas, while narrow pale accents give small upright forms definition. Rounded masses repeat at different scales, and straight horizontal bands settle the lower half into a calm rhythm. Edges are softly worked but remain clear enough to keep each color field distinct; small strokes and grain lend the smooth-looking slopes a tactile density. Light is mild and slanting, warming selected areas without dissolving the darker enclosing masses. The overall effect is pastoral, still, and subtly uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有哑光、细密点染的油画表面，乡野形状轻微几何化，空间层次被压缩。苔绿、橄榄绿、低饱和金色和深蓝绿覆盖相邻的大色域，窄浅色强调让小小的竖向形体显现。圆形体量以不同尺度重复，笔直横带让画面下部形成安静节奏。边缘经柔和处理，却清晰到足以区分各色块；小笔触与颗粒让看似平滑的坡面有了可触的密度。光线温和且倾斜，只温暖局部而不消散深色的包围体量。整体效果田园、静止，又有微妙的异样感。
theme_en: Four figures beside haystacks in a quiet green field
theme_zh: 四个人站在安静绿野的草垛旁
name: David Inshaw
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
